Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: reseller entitlement mapping + subscriber workflow

Hi Amy / Carlos,

Thanks for hopping on the call earlier. Per our discussion at the AWS partner sync, BrightScale will be the reseller on the CPPO for the BrightScale -> Acme Corp opportunity (Deal RDW-PP-2027-493). We want to confirm the operational flow so the customer can subscribe via the AWS Marketplace while BrightScale handles the commercial relationship and invoicing.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm which Marketplace product code/entitlement SKU BrightScale needs to create (we've proposed product code: RDW-BS-001).
- Confirm how the CPPO will surface the customer (Acme) subscription to BrightScale for invoicing and consolidated billing.
- Agreement on test purchase in AWS sandbox (account ids attached) and timing.

I've attached a proposed entitlement matrix (reseller_entitlements_matrix.xlsx) and a CPPO flow diagram (ppo_flow_diagram.png). Can you confirm gaps and owners?

Planned owners:
- Redwood (me): finalize SKU mapping and provide test artifacts.
- BrightScale (Amy): register product code & confirm entitlement behavior.
- AWS (Carlos): enable CPPO registration and confirm sandbox test flow.

If we can align by EOD next Wednesday (2027-05-26), we can push DocuSign and get the private offer live the following week.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: Private Offer: reseller entitlement mapping + subscriber workflow

Dylan — thanks for the notes and the artifacts. Quick clarifying questions after I reviewed the entitlement matrix:

1) SKU granularity: Do you want BrightScale to create a single umbrella SKU that maps to multiple seat tiers (we'd return quantity as seat count), or separate SKUs per tier? Our marketplace onboarding prefers one product code + metering via quantity for seat-based offers.

2) Billing entity: Acme has two billing entities (Acme US and Acme EU). For now this PO is US-only; will Redwood need a separate CPPO per billing entity?

3) Reseller margin & invoice flow: We need an explicit line in the DocuSign PO that states BrightScale is the commercial counterparty and Redwood will accept marketplace usage reporting for settlement. Can your legal team provide a snippet?

We can register the product code this week if you confirm SKU approach. Re: sandbox tests — please send the AWS sandbox account IDs and we will schedule a short test next Tue (25th).

—Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Channel Ops | BrightScale Systems

Amy — short answers inline:  

1) Recommend single product code + quantity metering for seat tiers. Fewer SKUs reduces friction for CPPO and mapping to usage reports. We'll expose tier-level pricing in the private offer pricing table rather than separate product codes.

2) US-only for this CPPO is fine. If Acme requires EU billing later we can create a separate CPPO tied to the EU billing entity. We'll document that in the rollout checklist.

3) Legal snippet: we will provide a short clause that says: "Reseller (BrightScale) will be recognized as the commercial counterparty for invoicing and Redwood Inference will rely on AWS Marketplace usage and settlement reports for revenue recognition and partner settlement." I'll loop in Contracts if you need stronger language.

Also adding a note: to avoid duplicate subscriptions, BrightScale must ensure the marketplace listing uses the same product code across all reseller offers.

Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Folks — operational checklist and owners (actionable items):

1) Product code registration (BrightScale) — due 2027-05-26. Deliverable: AWS product code and console screenshot.
2) Entitlement mapping confirmation (Redwood) — due 2027-05-26. Deliverable: updated reseller_entitlements_matrix.xlsx with final SKU->metric mapping.
3) Sandbox test (BrightScale + AWS + Redwood) — schedule for 2027-05-25 or 2027-05-27. Deliverable: successful test purchase + subscription visible to BrightScale.
4) DocuSign PO prep (Redwood legal + Ben) — draft by 2027-05-27. Deliverable: cp_po_template.docx with reseller counterparty clause.
5) Go-live date target: 2027-06-02.

I'll attach a minimal CPPO runbook in the drive link for BrightScale to follow. Also, note some AWS Marketplace quirks: the customer subscription shows as the buyer account, but the reseller is set in the CPPO terms — ensure BrightScale's billing contact is set in the offer metadata.

Soojin Lee
